description_en: Welcome to Odd Annals, where history and unsolved mysteries come alive through immersive 3D animated documentaries. 📜 Dive deep into forgotten chapters of time, ancient India, lost cities, and captivating mythologies that history textbooks gloss over. We bring you one detailed story every day alongside quick Shorts exploring bizarre facts. Subscribe to unearth the weirdest truths from our past! 🏛️
